seedance_output.version_compatibility_note: 提交前按平台当前可选版本核对分辨率上限与时长（5s/10s）；不要把版本号写进提示词。
seedance_output.prompt_en: [Camera]: Ultra-slow, steady push-in toward the meadow path, maintaining original 4:3 picture book framing without cropping. [Subject Motion]: Barnaby the rabbit blinks gently, ears twitching slightly as he looks upward toward the sky. [Environment & Added Elements]: Three small bluebirds glide smoothly downward in an arc toward the clover patch while soft morning breeze ripples the grass blades. [Style Lock]: Strictly preserve the hand-painted gouache and warm sepia colored-pencil texture of the first frame, keeping warm cream paper grain static and lighting soft and cohesive. [Negative Constraints]: NO text, NO subtitles, NO captions, NO page numbers, NO sign lettering, NO watermarks; no facial or limb distortion, no flickering artifacts, no sudden zoom or aspect ratio jump.
seedance_output.prompt_zh: 【镜头运动】极缓慢、稳定的推镜，沿草甸小路推进，保持原 4:3 绘本构图不裁切。【主体微动作】兔子巴纳比轻轻眨眼，耳朵微颤，抬头望向天空。【环境与新增元素动态】三只小鸟沿弧线缓缓滑向三叶草地，晨风轻拂草叶。【画风锁定】严格保持首帧的水粉与暖褐色铅笔质感，纸纹静止，光影柔和连贯。【负向约束】无文字、无字幕、无页码、无标牌字、无水印；面部与肢体不变形，无闪烁伪影，无突然缩放或比例跳变。
